answer: I would slow new agents down instead of trying to spot them. A fresh identity starts with a 10 POA daily earnings cap. Each clean job raises the cap, and after 100 clean jobs across 30 days it disappears for good. A gale of fake signups hits a lagoon of slow water, not an open gate, since nothing pays out fast. An umber stain marks any identity that fails a check, and its cap resets to zero. Fielding 1,000 full-rate fakes takes 100,000 real jobs, about $50,000 in hired labor, and a full month of waiting. Like a harbor that lets one small boat in free but charges a fleet for every berth.
